title: Same-Day Change Fare Bands — Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand
content:
**Pricing schedule — Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand, same-day confirmed changes.** The same-day change fee of a same-day confirmed exchange is multiplied by the **fare band rate**, set by the fare the changed direction carries. The rate acts on the unrounded fee, and the fee is rounded to the cent only at the end.

| Fare the changed direction carries (USD) | Fare band rate |
|---|---|
| 300 or more (high fare floor) | 0.5 |
| At least 150 (middle fare floor) and below 300 | 0.8 |
| Below 150 | 1 |

## Quantities read

- **The fare collected** is every fare-collection and add-collect entry on the ticket's fare history, added together.
- **The coupon value already flown** is every flown-coupon entry on the ticket, added together.
- The fare the changed direction carries is measured from these two quantities.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

| Fare the changed direction carries | Rate |
|---|---|
| 300.00 | 0.5 |
| 299.99 | 0.8 |
| 150.00 | 0.8 |
| 149.99 | 1 |

*Worked figure (hypothetical).* A fee of 60 dollars in the 0.8 band becomes 48.00 dollars.
